## Automated Tests Required

### CI-001: CI/CD Workflow Setup — Config/Data
**Manual verification only**:
- [ ] `.github/workflows/test.yml` exists and is committed
- [ ] Workflow runs `go test marrow-of-empire-tests/...` on push/PR
- [ ] First CI run passes — all tests green

### COMBAT-001: Square Grid & Movement — Logic (inferred)
**Test file**: `tests/unit/combat/grid_test.go`
**What to test** (from TR-combat-001, ADR-0009):
- Grid coordinates: 1 unit = 1 meter
- Diagonal movement costs 1 AP
- Movement range calculation from AP budget
- Pathfinding stub (straight-line distance)
- Out-of-bounds / blocked tile rejection

**Formulas**: `distance = |dx| + |dy|` (Chebyshev for square grid with diagonals)
**Estimated tests**: ~5

### COMBAT-002: AP System & Initiative — Logic (inferred)
**Test file**: `tests/unit/combat/ap_initiative_test.go`
**What to test** (from TR-combat-002, ADR-0009):
- AP = 4 + DEX_mod (min 2, max 8)
- Initiative = DEX_mod + WIS_mod
- Turn order sorted by initiative (descending)
- AP reset at turn start
- AP consumed by move (1), attack (2), ability (1-3)

**Edge cases**: DEX 3 (-4 mod) → AP = 2 (min); DEX 20 (+4 clamped) → AP = 8
**Estimated tests**: ~5
